---
title: "Kantsoner langs åker"
author: "Jenny Hansen"
format: html
editor: visual
---

Load required libraries

```{r echo=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(sf)
library(terra)
library(rgrass)
library(mapview)
```

Set up grass environment

```{r echo=FALSE}

# connect to GRASS
NinaR::grassConnect(location = "ETRS_32N", mapset = "p_Restaurerbar_Akershus")

execGRASS("g.region", vector = "akershus_vect", flags = "p", res = "5")
execGRASS("g.remove", type = "raster", name = "MASK", flags = "f")

```

Import data

```{r echo=FALSE}

# AR5 polygons
ar5 <- st_read("/data/R/GeoSpatialData/Topography/Norway_FKB/Original/FKB-AR5 FGDB-format/Basisdata_32_Akershus_25832_FKB-AR5_FGDB.gdb", layer = "fkb_ar5_omrade")

# Pollinator prediction raster
poll <- rast("/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Data/Kantsoner/polliland_akershus.tif")

# Gråareal
ga <- st_read("/data/R/GeoSpatialData/LandCover/Norway_Grå_Arealer_versjon1/Original/Kart over grå arealer GeoPackage-format/32_25835_graastruktur_gpkg.gpkg", layer = "GraaArealFlate") %>% 
  st_transform(25832)

# jordkvalitet
jk <- st_read("/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Data/Kantsoner/jordkvalitet.gpkg", layer = "jordkvalitet") %>% 
  mutate(jordkvalitet = as.numeric(jordkvalitet))# 1 = svært god, 2 = god, 3 = mindre god

# invasive species
invasive <- rast("/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Data/Kantsoner/invasive_neighborhood.tif")
```

Reclassify AR5

```{r echo=FALSE}

# classify fulldyrka jord and overflatedyrka jord as åker
# everything else as NA
aker <- ar5 %>%
  mutate(kantklasse = if_else(arealtype %in% c("21", "22", "23"), "Aker", NA_character_)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(kantklasse)) %>%
  st_make_valid() %>%
  st_cast("MULTIPOLYGON") %>%
  st_cast("POLYGON") %>%
  mutate(field_id = row_number())

skog <- ar5 %>%
  filter(arealtype == 30) |> 
  rename(geom = SHAPE) |> 
  st_make_valid()

rm(ar5)
```

Write vector data to grass mapset

```{r echo=FALSE}

write_VECT(vect(aker), "aker_vect", flags = "overwrite")
write_VECT(vect(skog), "skog_vect")
write_VECT(vect(ga), "graareal_vect")
write_VECT(vect(jk), "jordkvalitet_vect", flags = "overwrite")
```

Rasterize vector data

```{r echo=FALSE}

# Åker
execGRASS("v.to.rast",
          input = "aker_vect",
          output = "aker_rast",
          use = "cat",
          flags = "overwrite")

# Skog
execGRASS("v.to.rast",
          input = "skog_vect",
          output = "skog_rast",
          use = "val",
          value = 1,
          flags = "overwrite")

# Gråareal
execGRASS("v.to.rast",
          input = "graareal_vect",
          output = "graareal_rast",
          use = "val",
          value = 1,
          flags = "overwrite")

# Jordkvalitet
execGRASS("v.to.rast",
          input = "jordkvalitet_vect",
          output = "jordkvalitet_rast",
          use = "attr",
          attribute_column = "jordkvalitet",
          flags = "overwrite")

# Grow distance from åker rast
execGRASS("r.grow.distance",
          input = "aker_rast",
          distance = "dist_to_aker",
          value = "nearest_field_id",
          flags = "overwrite")

# create a field margin raster & remove areas overlapping gråareal and skog
execGRASS("r.mapcalc",
          expression = "kant_rast = if(dist_to_aker <= 15 && isnull(aker_rast) && isnull(graareal_rast) && isnull(skog_rast), nearest_field_id, null())",
          flags = "overwrite")

```

Zonal extraction of relevant values

```{r echo=FALSE}

kant_id <- read_RAST("kant_rast")
jk_rast <- read_RAST("jordkvalitet_rast")

# handle mask values in invasive raster
inv_clean <- as.numeric(invasive)
inv_clean[inv_clean > 1000] <- NA

# resample rasters to match åker kant
inv_a <- resample(inv_clean, kant_id, method = "near")
poll_a <- resample(poll, kant_id, method = "bilinear")
jk_a   <- resample(jk_rast, kant_id, method = "near")

# extract summary values 
inv_max  <- zonal(inv_a, kant_id, fun = "max", na.rm = TRUE)
poll_mean <- zonal(poll_a, kant_id, fun = "mean", na.rm = TRUE)
jk_dom <- zonal(jk_a, kant_id, fun = "modal", na.rm = TRUE)
jk_mean   <- zonal(jk_a, kant_id, fun = "mean", na.rm = TRUE)

```

Polygonize output

```{r echo=FALSE}

execGRASS("r.to.vect",
          input = "kant_rast",
          output = "kant_vect",
          type = "area",
          flags = "overwrite")

# mapping shows areas covered by skog as an artifact of the r.to.vect process; need to remove
execGRASS("v.overlay",
          ainput = "kant_vect",
          binput = "skog_vect",
          operator = "not",
          output = "kant_vect_clean",
          flags = "overwrite")

execGRASS("v.out.ogr",
          input = "kant_vect_clean",
          output = "/data/scratch/tmp_jenny/gpkg/kant_vect_clean.gpkg",
          format = "GPKG",
          flags = "overwrite")

kant_poly <- st_read("/data/scratch/tmp_jenny/gpkg/kant_vect_clean.gpkg")
```

Build summary data

```{r echo=FALSE}

poll_mean <- poll_mean %>%
  setNames(c("field_id", "poll_mean"))

inv_max <- inv_max %>%
  setNames(c("field_id", "inv_max"))

jk_dom <- jk_dom %>%
  setNames(c("field_id", "jk_dom"))

summ <- poll_mean %>%
  left_join(inv_max, by = "field_id") %>%
  left_join(jk_dom, by = "field_id")

# join with polygons
kant_poly <- kant_poly %>%
  rename(field_id = a_value)

kant_vars <- kant_poly %>%
  left_join(summ, by = "field_id")
```

Find suitable polygons

```{r echo=FALSE}

# remove polygons lacking values
kant_filtered <- kant_vars %>% 
  filter(!is.na(poll_mean),
         !is.na(inv_max),
         !is.na(jk_dom)) %>% 
  mutate(area = as.numeric(st_area(.))) %>% 
  filter(area >= 1000)

# summary values
summary(kant_filtered$poll_mean)
summary(kant_filtered$inv_max)
summary(kant_filtered$jk_dom)

# using mean values for pollinators & invasive, plus worst soil class
kant_all <- kant_filtered %>% 
  filter(jk_dom >= 2,
         inv_max >= 2.5,
         poll_mean >= 3) # n = 228
mapview(kant_all, zcol = "poll_mean")
```

Export data

```{r echo=FALSE}

# write to scratch temporarily and copy to P drive
out_gpkg <- "/data/scratch/tmp_jenny/gpkg/kantsoner_langs_aker_v2.gpkg"
st_write(kant_all, out_gpkg, layer = "kantsoner_langs_aker_v2")

file.copy(
  from = out_gpkg,
  to = "/data/P-Prosjekter2/155014_restaurerbar_natur_akershus/2026/Kriteriekart/kantsoner_langs_aker_v2.gpkg",
  overwrite = TRUE)
```
